# akeyless-watchover usage guide (v1.2.0)

Two ways to use akeyless-watchover:

1. **Talk to Claude** with the skill installed: use a *skill command* (below) or just describe the task.
2. **Run the kit** in your governance repository with `scripts/watchover <command>` (Python 3.10+, `pyyaml`;
   Terraform >= 1.7 or OpenTofu >= 1.8; the `akeyless` CLI for live commands).

`scripts/watchover help` prints everything in this guide in the terminal.

## 1. Skill commands (Claude)

Claude Code: `/akeyless-watchover <command> [args]`. Claude (web/desktop): write
`akeyless-watchover <command> [args]` or `/akeyless-watchover ...` - or simply describe the task; the skill also
triggers without a command.

| Command | Arguments | Purpose | Delivers | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `help` | [command] | Show this guide, or the details of one skill command. | The command table, parameters and examples. | `/akeyless-watchover help design` |
| `design` | &lt;diagram / description of BUs, apps, environments, personas&gt; | Translate an organisation/structure diagram into Akeyless configuration. | Path tree, access matrix, YAML model (roles, auth methods, folders), access expectations, plan expectations, CLI equivalent. | `/akeyless-watchover design <paste or attach the diagram>` |
| `change` | &lt;access request in plain words&gt; | Change existing access with the smallest possible model diff. | Diff of model/roles/&lt;bu&gt;.yaml (and auth_methods.yaml if needed), new expectations, who must approve (CODEOWNERS). | `/akeyless-watchover change give fraud-analysts read on /payments/+/prod/*` |
| `review` | &lt;model files, merge-request diff or plan output&gt; | Review a proposed change for least privilege, guard violations and blast radius. | Findings by severity, failing guards, missing expectations, plan red flags (replacements). | `/akeyless-watchover review <paste the plan>` |
| `pipeline` | [github / gitlab] [repository] | Set up the governance repository: bootstrap identity, CI, CODEOWNERS, state. | bootstrap.tfvars, CI file, variables to create, step-by-step order. | `/akeyless-watchover pipeline gitlab group/akeyless-governance` |
| `import` | [what to export: everything / a type / one user's view] [export directory or REPORT.md] | Export existing config (RBAC, auth methods incl. OIDC, folders, custom fields, key policies, PKI issuers, account settings) and translate it into Terraform. | The exact `watchover export` command (model or --hcl mode, filters), then resolution of every REPORT.md item and the import checklist until the plan shows imports only. | `/akeyless-watchover import the OIDC auth method and everything alice@example.com can reach` |
| `conjur` | &lt;Conjur policy YAML&gt; | Migrate from CyberArk Conjur: secrets via the Gateway, RBAC via translation. | Translated roles, bindings to fill (auth method + sub-claims), migration resource, cut-over plan. | `/akeyless-watchover conjur <attach policy files>` |
| `pki` | &lt;certificate requirements&gt; | Design private/public CA issuers and who may request certificates. | pki.yaml (CA keys, issuers), requester roles, expiry forwarder, CLI to issue/revoke. | `/akeyless-watchover pki internal TLS for *.payments.internal, 90 days, auto-renew` |
| `harden` | [current settings or concerns] | Account-level hardening. | governance.yaml: account_settings (Terraform), account_settings_cli (CLI), custom fields, key policies, event forwarders. | `/akeyless-watchover harden` |
| `gateway` | &lt;who administers which Gateway, SIEM target&gt; | Gateway admin plane and audit-log forwarding. | gateway.yaml (allowed_access, log_forwarding), gateway_api setup. | `/akeyless-watchover gateway platform admins full, PKI team targets only, Splunk` |
| `verify` | [persona / path] | Prove who can access what. | access_expectations.yaml checks, `watchover simulate` / `watchover verify` commands, Impersonate As steps. | `/akeyless-watchover verify can the checkout pods read refunds prod?` |
| `cli` | &lt;task&gt; | Exact Akeyless CLI commands for a task (break-glass, bootstrap, one-off checks). | Commands checked against the CLI reference, with the equivalent model change. | `/akeyless-watchover cli create a temporary read rule for 60 minutes` |
| `explain` | &lt;topic&gt; | Explain an Akeyless concept precisely (sub-claims, deny, wildcards, anti-escalation...). | A short answer with the verified facts and VERIFY caveats. | `/akeyless-watchover explain sub-claims AND/OR` |

## 2. Kit commands (`scripts/watchover`)

| Command | Summary | Needs Akeyless |
|---|---|---|
| [`test`](#watchover-test) | Run every offline check (what CI runs). | no |
| [`simulate`](#watchover-simulate) | Offline: evaluate access_expectations.yaml against the model. | no |
| [`verify`](#watchover-verify) | Live: compare expectations with describe-permissions run as each persona's CLI profile. | yes |
| [`export`](#watchover-export) | Export existing config and translate it: YAML model + import blocks, or plain Terraform (--hcl). | yes |
| [`conjur`](#watchover-conjur) | Translate Conjur policy into model roles + identity bindings. | no |
| [`account-settings`](#watchover-account-settings) | Apply account_settings_cli (settings the provider cannot manage) with the CLI. | yes |
| [`token`](#watchover-token) | CI: exchange the pipeline JWT for an Akeyless token. | yes |
| [`build-skill`](#watchover-build-skill) | Package the skill ZIP. | no |
| `help [command\|skill] [--markdown]` | Help in the terminal; `--markdown` regenerates this guide. | no |
| `version` | Print the version. | no |

### watchover test

Run the complete offline test suite (no Akeyless account needed): fmt, validate, terraform test, guard messages, export round trip, bootstrap tests, access simulation, script tests, guide drift check.

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tool` | terraform/tofu | default terraform | IaC binary to use |
| `--skip-iac` | - | optional | only run the Python checks |

```bash
scripts/watchover test
scripts/watchover test --tool tofu
```

### watchover simulate

Offline access check of the YAML model against expected access (no Akeyless calls).

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--model` | MODEL | required | model directory (terraform/model) |
| `--expectations` | EXPECTATIONS | required | access_expectations.yaml |
| `--explain` | - | optional | print the matching rules for every check, not only failures |

```bash
scripts/watchover simulate --model terraform/model --expectations terraform/model/access_expectations.yaml --explain
```

### watchover verify

Live access verification against Akeyless (after apply).

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--expectations` | EXPECTATIONS | required | access_expectations.yaml (personas need a 'profile') |
| `--akeyless` | AKEYLESS | default akeyless | path to the akeyless CLI binary |
| `--error-means-no-access` | - | optional | treat a failing describe-permissions call as 'no permissions' (check the CLI behaviour first) |

```bash
scripts/watchover verify --expectations terraform/model/access_expectations.yaml
```

### watchover export

Export an existing Akeyless account and translate it into Terraform.

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out` | OUT | required | output directory (model/, imports.tf or hcl/, raw/, REPORT.md) |
| `--profile` | PROFILE | optional | akeyless CLI profile with read access to the objects to export |
| `--akeyless` | AKEYLESS | default akeyless | path to the akeyless CLI binary |
| `--from-dir` | FROM_DIR | optional | replay a raw/ directory of a previous export instead of calling the CLI |
| `--types` | TYPES | default roles,auth-methods,folders,custom-fields,key-policies,pki-issuers,account-settings | comma-separated object families: roles, auth-methods, folders, custom-fields, key-policies, pki-issuers, account-settings |
| `--only` | ONLY | optional | keep only objects whose name matches this regex |
| `--exclude` | EXCLUDE | repeatable | regex of names to skip (repeatable) |
| `--root` | ROOT | default / | folder to start the item/folder walk from |
| `--max-depth` | MAX_DEPTH | default 20 | maximum folder depth of the walk |
| `--persona-auth-method` | PERSONA_AUTH_METHOD | optional | keep one identity's view: its auth method ... |
| `--persona-claim` | PERSONA_CLAIM | repeatable | ... and its claims, key=value (repeatable); keeps roles whose association matches |
| `--hcl` | - | optional | write plain Terraform import blocks for every object (hcl/) |
| `--generate` | - | optional | with --hcl: run 'terraform plan -generate-config-out' (needs terraform and AKEYLESS_ACCESS_ID/AKEYLESS_ACCESS_KEY in the environment) |
| `--terraform` | TERRAFORM | default terraform | terraform or tofu binary used by --generate |

```bash
scripts/watchover export --out export/ --profile admin --exclude '^/governance/auth/ci-terraform$'
scripts/watchover export --out export/ --profile admin --types auth-methods --only sso
scripts/watchover export --out export/ --profile admin --persona-auth-method /governance/auth/sso-entra-oidc --persona-claim email=alice@example.com --persona-claim groups=grp-akl-payments-admins
AKEYLESS_ACCESS_ID=p-... AKEYLESS_ACCESS_KEY=... scripts/watchover export --out export/ --profile admin --hcl --generate
scripts/watchover export --out export2/ --from-dir export/raw     # offline replay
```

### watchover conjur

Translate CyberArk Conjur policy (RBAC) into the akeyless-watchover YAML model.

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy` | POLICY... | required | Conjur policy YAML files (loaded at the root namespace in the given order) |
| `--item-prefix` | ITEM_PREFIX | default /conjur | Akeyless folder the Gateway migration imports into |
| `--role-prefix` | ROLE_PREFIX | default /governance/roles/ | prefix of the generated Akeyless role names |
| `--out` | OUT | required | output directory (roles/conjur.yaml, bindings.yaml, REPORT.md) |

```bash
scripts/watchover conjur root.yml prod.yml --item-prefix /conjur --out export/conjur
```

### watchover account-settings

Apply the account settings that Terraform provider 2.0.5 cannot manage.

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--governance` | GOVERNANCE | required | path to model/governance.yaml (reads account_settings_cli) |
| `--profile` | PROFILE | optional | akeyless CLI profile of an account admin |
| `--token` | TOKEN | optional | Akeyless token (default: $AKEYLESS_TOKEN, e.g. from 'watchover token') |
| `--akeyless` | AKEYLESS | default akeyless | path to the akeyless CLI binary |
| `--dry-run` | - | optional | print the update-account-settings command, do not run it |

| Environment variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AKEYLESS_TOKEN` | token used when --token is not given |

```bash
scripts/watchover account-settings --governance terraform/model/governance.yaml --dry-run
AKEYLESS_TOKEN=$(scripts/watchover token) scripts/watchover account-settings --governance terraform/model/governance.yaml
```

### watchover token

Exchange a CI OIDC/JWT for a short-lived Akeyless token (REST POST /auth, access-type jwt). Prints the token.

| Parameter | Value | Required / default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--api` | API | optional | Akeyless API (default: $AKEYLESS_API or https://api.akeyless.io) |
| `--access-id` | ACCESS_ID | optional | access ID of the CI auth method (default: $AKEYLESS_ACCESS_ID) |
| `--jwt` | JWT | optional | the CI-issued JWT (default: $CI_JWT; prefer the env var - arguments are visible in the process list) |

| Environment variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AKEYLESS_API` | API base URL |
| `AKEYLESS_ACCESS_ID` | CI auth method access ID |
| `CI_JWT` | CI-issued JWT |

```bash
CI_JWT=$JWT AKEYLESS_ACCESS_ID=p-xxxx scripts/watchover token
```

### watchover build-skill

Build dist/akeyless-watchover.zip (SKILL.md + references/ + template/) for upload to Claude or unzip into ~/.claude/skills/.

No parameters.

```bash
scripts/watchover build-skill
```

## 3. Typical sessions

**New design**
```text
/akeyless-watchover design <diagram>
-> review the five artifacts -> commit model changes -> scripts/watchover test -> merge request
```

**Access change**
```text
/akeyless-watchover change <request>
-> scripts/watchover simulate ... -> merge request (plan in CI) -> merge (apply)
```

**Existing account**
```text
scripts/watchover export --out export/ --profile admin ...
/akeyless-watchover import export/REPORT.md -> move files -> plan shows only imports -> apply
```

**Conjur**
```text
scripts/watchover conjur policy.yml --out export/conjur
/akeyless-watchover conjur export/conjur/bindings.yaml -> fill bindings -> gateway migration -> cut-over
```

## 4. Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success / all expectations met |
| 1 | check failed (mismatch, drift, failed step) |
| 2 | usage, model or execution error |
